# MAX Number Checker API

> Official CheckNumber code examples for a bulk, asynchronous API used to verify MAX messenger registration and optionally retrieve documented profile fields.

Base URL: https://api.checknumber.ai
Authentication: X-API-Key request header

## Workflow

1. Submit: POST https://api.checknumber.ai/v1/tasks with `file` and `task_type=max`.
2. Poll: POST https://api.checknumber.ai/v1/gettasks with `task_id`.
3. Download: retrieve `result_url` after status becomes `exported`.

## Variants

- `task_type=max` — MAX Number Checker: https://docs.checknumber.ai/max-checker
- `task_type=max_full` — MAX Full Profile Checker: https://docs.checknumber.ai/max-full-checker

## Pricing

Current terms: https://checknumber.ai/pricing
Balance endpoint: GET https://api.checknumber.ai/v1/balance

## Docs

- Canonical documentation: https://docs.checknumber.ai/max-checker
- Dashboard and API keys: https://platform.checknumber.ai
